subject: P-7F3K9Q.T2

findings.title: Duplicate check scans the whole tags array
findings.detail: addTag checks for an existing tag with Array.includes on every call. Fine for the handful of tags a note has; a Set would matter only if notes carried hundreds of tags.

summary: The diff trims, NFC-normalizes and lowercases tags before storing them and skips a tag the note already has. Old records without tags load as empty. No tag value is logged. One minor finding.
